items.title: How AI Tools Generate Technical Debt in IoT Systems — and What to Do About It
items.description: AI tools speed up IoT development — but closer to the hardware, the same code that looks correct can silently break thousands of devices at once. The post How AI Tools Generate Technical Debt in IoT Systems — and What to Do About It appeared first on Towards Data Science.
items.tldr: AIツールはIoT開発を加速させるが、ハードウェアに近い部分では正しく見えるコードが一度に何千ものデバイスを壊す可能性があり、これが技術的負債を生む原因となる。

items.tldr: AIを鍛えようとした結果、期待したほどAIは上達せず、逆に自分自身が謎かけのスキルを向上させたという体験が報告されている。

items.title: ASUS Starves the RTX 5070 Ti as Memory Shortages Force a Pivot Toward the More Profitable RTX 5080
items.description: ASUS is planning to limit the production of its RTX 5070 Ti GPUs and prioritize the higher-end RTX 5080 models in its place. ASUS Prioritizes Higher-End RTX 5080 GPUs By Limiting Other 16 GB Models, Such As The RTX 5070 Ti While NVIDIA has confirmed that production across all RTX 50 GPUs remains sta
items.tldr: ASUSはメモリ不足の影響でRTX 5070 Tiの生産を制限し、より利益率の高いRTX 5080モデルの生産を優先する方針を示しています。

items.title: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495 APU could arrive with 192GB of unified memory — leaked PassMark benchmarks suggest modest update over Strix Halo
items.description: The Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495 appears to retain the same core configuration as its predecessor while adding more unified memory and slightly better performance.
items.tldr: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495 APUは、前モデルと同じコア構成を維持しつつ、192GBの統合メモリと若干の性能向上を実現する模様です。

items.title: Reggie Fils-Aimé Defends Nintendo’s Full-Price Forever Policy, Pointing to Kyoto Roots Most Gamers Never Consider
items.description: Long-time gamers know all too well that Nintendo has a rather unique policy when it comes to discounts for its exclusive games: they rarely, if ever, exist. Most of the time, you'll see Nintendo titles keeping their full price even years after their release, whereas every other platform, be it other
items.tldr: レジー・フィルス＝アミーが任天堂のフルプライス維持政策を擁護し、その背景には京都の文化があると指摘した。任天堂の独占ゲームは、他のプラットフォームと異なり、リリースから数年経っても価格がほとんど変わらないことが多い。

items.title: AMD’s Entry-Level Ryzen AI 5 435G Matches Ryzen 5 8600G in Leaked Benchmark, Despite Running Well Below Its Boost Clock
items.description: AMD's upcoming Ryzen AI 5 435G Desktop APU has leaked out, showcasing benchmark performance similar to Ryzen 8000G APUs. AMD Ryzen AI 400 Desktop APUs Bring The Latest Architectures To AM5 Platforms, Ryzen AI 5 435G Shows Similar Performance As 8600G The AMD Ryzen AI 400 Desktop APUs will be launchi
items.tldr: AMDの新しいRyzen AI 5 435GデスクトップAPUがリークされ、ブーストクロックを下回る動作にもかかわらず、Ryzen 5 8600Gと同等のベンチマーク性能を示しています。

items.title: Steam Controller interview full transcript — Valve programmer and engineer discuss design, latency, prototyping, and the joys of not having a kernel driver
items.description: Valve sat down with Tom's Hardware to discuss the new Steam Controller, its design, dealing with latency, and why you really need Steam to use it.
items.tldr: ValveがTom's Hardwareとのインタビューで新しいSteam Controllerのデザインやレイテンシーへの対処法、そして使用にはSteamが必要な理由について語った。

items.title: Crushing shortages have pushed long-term supply agreements for SSDs and HDDs to record five years — large customers are signing large contracts
items.description: Demand for storage devices is so high that large customers are willing to sign up to five-year long-term supply agreements, according to Sandisk, Seagate, and Western Digital.
items.tldr: ストレージデバイスの需要が高まる中、大手顧客はSandisk、Seagate、Western Digitalと最大5年の長期供給契約を結ぶ意向を示している。

items.title: Resident Evil Requiem Producer Dodges NVIDIA DLSS 5 Question, But Fan Reaction to Her Design Speaks Louder Than Words
items.description: Resident Evil Requiem running with NVIDIA DLSS 5 was among the most controversial showcases of the upcoming technology, if not the most controversial, as it seemed to alter Grace's character design significantly. Speaking with Eurogamer, Producer Masato Kumazawa refused to comment directly on the te
items.tldr: Resident Evil Requiemのプロデューサー、熊沢雅人氏はNVIDIA DLSS 5についての質問には直接答えなかったが、キャラクターデザインの変更に対するファンの反応が注目を集めている。

items.title: AMD Ryzen 9 PRO 9965X3D spotted on Passmark — company's first PRO chip with 3D V-Cache also bumps the lineup up to 16 cores
items.description: A new Ryzen PRO series processor has appeared on PassMark with just three samples, but a very promising spec sheet. The Ryzen 9 PRO 9965X3D is a 16-core Zen 5 chip with 3D V-Cache, making it the first of its kind. It performs quite closely to the standard 9950X3D it's based on, but likely has a lowe
items.tldr: AMDの新しいRyzen 9 PRO 9965X3DがPassMarkに登場し、16コアのZen 5アーキテクチャと3D V-Cacheを搭載した初のPROチップとなる。性能は基盤となる9950X3Dに近いが、消費電力は低い可能性がある。

items.title: PlayStation 6 PSSR Frame Gen Inches Closer to Reality, As Sony Doubles Down On AI Interpolation Research
items.description: The launch of the PlayStation 5 Pro marked the debut of AI-powered upscaling in the console space with PSSR. While the upscaler's latest version significantly improves image quality over its launch iteration, there's a very strong chance that, on PlayStation 6, the upscaler will also deliver AI-powe
items.tldr: PlayStation 6では、AI補間技術がさらに進化し、PSSRフレーム生成が現実に近づいている。ソニーはAIインターポレーション研究に注力しており、次世代コンソールでの画質向上が期待される。

items.title: GTA 6 Final Crunch Hits Rockstar Hard, With QA Staff Working Until 3 AM as November Deadline Looms
items.description: It looks like Take-Two and Rockstar Games are both pushing to avoid a third GTA 6 delay. Just last week, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick shrugged off delay rumors, pointing out that many people will likely take a sick day on November 19, the current release date for Grand Theft Auto 6. The toll of this
items.tldr: GTA 6のリリースが迫る中、Rockstar GamesはQAスタッフに深夜3時までの勤務を強いるなど、最終的な仕上げに苦しんでいる。Take-TwoのCEOは、11月19日の発売日を守るための遅延の噂を否定した。

items.title: Apple Held The Line On MacBook Pricing While Microsoft Hiked Surface Prices, But The iPhone 18 Is Where The Streak Reportedly Breaks
items.description: When market distortions become so extreme that the underlying economics stop making sense, retreat is the only recourse. And, this is exactly what Morgan Stanley is now betting on in relation to Apple's ongoing bid for uncontested market share supremacy via a combination of price freezes and strateg
items.tldr: AppleはMacBookの価格を維持している一方で、MicrosoftはSurfaceの価格を引き上げているが、iPhone 18ではこの価格戦略が崩れる可能性があるとMorgan Stanleyが予測している。

items.title: ASUS ROG Crosshair X870E Hero AMD AM5 Motherboard Quick Look
items.description: We take a look at the ASUS ROG Crosshair X870E Hero which is an AMD socket AM5 motherboard with lots of neat features The post ASUS ROG Crosshair X870E Hero AMD AM5 Motherboard Quick Look appeared first on ServeTheHome.
items.tldr: ASUS ROG Crosshair X870E Heroは、AMD AM5ソケット対応のマザーボードで、多くの魅力的な機能を備えています。

items.title: Anthropic Eyes UK Startup’s Fusion Tech Promising 100x Faster AI Inference at One-Tenth the Cost of NVIDIA’s Groq
items.description: Anthropic, the creators of Claude AI, are reportedly in early talks with a UK startup whose SRAM tech can boost AI inference by 100x & reduce costs by 10x. Anthropic Reportedly In Early Talks With Fractile, A UK-based Startup Working on the fusion architecture as an AI Inference Booster Currentl
items.tldr: Anthropicは、AI推論を100倍高速化し、コストを10分の1に削減できるSRAM技術を持つ英国のスタートアップFractileとの初期協議を行っている。

items.title: NVIDIA Fast-Forwarded Co-Packaged Optics Five Years Ahead of Schedule, Arriving First With Its Feynman GPUs
items.description: NVIDIA's Feynman GPUs will be the first to feature Co-Packaged Optics, but this wasn't always the case until the AI giant decided to switch gears. Co-Packaged Optics Were Many Years Away, But NVIDIA Decided To Move Ahead With Its Feynman GPUs CPO or Co-Packaged Optics (Silicon Photonics) is the next
items.tldr: NVIDIAはFeynman GPUに初めてCo-Packaged Optics（CPO）を搭載し、当初の計画よりも5年早く市場に投入することを決定しました。

items.title: NVIDIA’s RTX 5050 Finally Crawls Onto Steam’s Hardware Survey, But It’s Already Trailing AMD’s Lone RDNA 4 Entry
items.description: After a long time, the entry-level RTX 50 series GPU made its debut on the Steam Hardware Survey charts. All NVIDIA RTX 50 GPUs Appear on Steam Hardware Survey With RTX 5050 As the Latest Entry; 16 GB VRAM GPUs Now Closer in Popularity to 8 GB GPUs The previous Steam Hardware Surveys recorded almost
items.tldr: NVIDIAのRTX 5050がSteamのハードウェア調査に登場したが、AMDのRDNA 4 GPUには及ばない人気を示している。

items.title: Enthusiast builds a PC big enough to live in — humans in this RGB-lit fish tank case look just like figurines
items.description: A Chinese TechTuber scaled a tower PC large enough for a human to work and play in. It has air conditioning, too.
items.tldr: 中国のTechTuberが、人間が中で作業や遊びができるほどの大きさのタワーPCを制作し、エアコンも搭載している。

items.title: Nvidia accelerates end-of-life for some Jetson AI processors due to memory shortages — RAMpocalypse sends older DDR4-based modules to the great scrapheap in the sky
items.description: Nvidia is apparently discontinuing some older embedded platforms earlier than anticipated, but this is mostly about market reality finally catching up, not abrupt discontinuation.
items.tldr: Nvidiaは、メモリ不足により一部の古いJetson AIプロセッサを予想より早く生産終了することを発表しましたが、これは市場の現実に対応した結果です。

items.title: Save $370 on this AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition with an X870E motherboard and 32GB of RAM — big savings for your next high-end build
items.description: This Newegg bundle offers cutting-edge performance with practical value, combining AMD’s latest flagship CPU with high-end supporting components at a discounted price.
items.tldr: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2とX870Eマザーボード、32GBのRAMを含むNeweggのバンドルが370ドルの割引で提供されており、高性能なハイエンドビルドに最適です。

items.title: A suspected YouTube interface bug spikes RAM usage above 7 gigabytes, users report severe lag and frozen tabs — bug might be trapping browsers in an endless layout loop
items.description: Reports of YouTube freezing browsers and consuming massive amounts of RAM are spreading online, with developers tracing the issue to a suspected UI bug that may trigger endless layout recalculations and severe system lag.
items.tldr: YouTubeのインターフェースに関する疑惑のバグがRAM使用量を7GB以上に増加させ、ブラウザがフリーズする問題が報告されており、開発者はこの問題が無限のレイアウト再計算を引き起こしている可能性があると追跡しています。

items.title: Popular 90s search engine ‘Ask Jeeves’ finally bites the dust — parent company shutters website that pioneered natural language queries, only a placeholder results page remains
items.description: IAC, the parent company of Ask Jeeves, is finally putting the search engine out to pasture after 30 years.
items.tldr: 90年代の人気検索エンジン「Ask Jeeves」が、親会社IACによって30年の歴史に幕を下ろし、現在はプレースホルダーの結果ページのみが残る。

items.title: CISA says ‘Copy Fail’ flaw now exploited to root Linux systems
items.description: CISA has warned that threat actors have started exploiting the "Copy Fail" Linux security vulnerability in the wild, one day after Theori researchers disclosed it and shared a proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit. [...]
items.tldr: CISAは、「Copy Fail」というLinuxのセキュリティ脆弱性が悪用され始めたと警告しており、これはTheoriの研究者が公開したPoCの翌日に発表されました。

items.title: How Dark Reading Lifted Off the Launchpad in 2006
items.description: Twenty years ago, this media brand didn't have a print edition to attract eyeballs and sponsors. Top-notch content and editorial talent did the heavy lifting.
items.tldr: TL;DR: Dark Readingは20年前、印刷版を持たずに優れたコンテンツと編集者の才能で成長し、スポンサーを惹きつけるメディアブランドとしての地位を確立した。

items.title: Microsoft confirms April Windows updates cause backup failures
items.description: Microsoft has confirmed that the April 2026 security updates are causing failures in third-party backup applications using the psmounterex.sys driver. [...]
items.tldr: Microsoftは2026年4月のセキュリティ更新が、psmounterex.sysドライバーを使用するサードパーティ製バックアップアプリケーションにおいて失敗を引き起こすことを確認しました。

items.title: Hacking Polymarket
items.description: Polymarket is a platform where people can bet on real-world events, political and otherwise. Leaving the ethical considerations of this aside (for one, it facilitates assassination), one of the issues with making this work is the verification of these real-world events. Polymarket gamblers have thre
items.tldr: TL;DR: Polymarketは現実の出来事に賭けるプラットフォームであるが、倫理的な問題や現実の出来事の検証が課題となっている。

items.title: Critical cPanel Vulnerability Weaponized to Target Government and MSP Networks
items.description: A previously unknown threat actor has been observed targeting government and military entities in Southeast Asia, alongside a smaller cluster of managed service providers (MSPs) and hosting providers in the Philippines, Laos, Canada, South Africa, and the U.S., by exploiting the recently disclosed v
items.tldr: cPanelの重大な脆弱性が、東南アジアの政府や軍事機関、フィリピン、ラオス、カナダ、南アフリカ、米国のマネージドサービスプロバイダー（MSP）を標的にした攻撃に悪用されていることが確認されました。

items.title: Global Crackdown Arrests 276, Shuts 9 Crypto Scam Centers, Seizes $701M
items.description: A coordinated international operation involving U.S. and Chinese authorities has arrested at least 276 suspects and shut down nine scam centers used for cryptocurrency investment fraud schemes targeting Americans, resulting in millions of dollars in losses. The crackdown was led by the Dubai Police,
items.tldr: 国際的な共同作戦により、アメリカと中国の当局が276人を逮捕し、アメリカ人を狙った暗号通貨投資詐欺のための9つの詐欺センターを閉鎖し、7億0100万ドルを押収した。

items.title: Instructure confirms data breach, ShinyHunters claims attack
items.description: Educational tech giant Instructure has confirmed that data was stolen in a cyberattack, with the ShinyHunters extortion gang claiming responsibility. [...]
items.tldr: 教育テクノロジー企業Instructureがサイバー攻撃によるデータ流出を確認し、ShinyHuntersという脅迫グループがその責任を主張しています。

items.title: Microsoft Defender wrongly flags DigiCert certs as Trojan:Win32/Cerdigent.A!dha
items.description: Microsoft Defender is detecting legitimate DigiCert root certificates as Trojan:Win32/Cerdigent.A!dha, resulting in widespread false-positive alerts, and in some cases, removing certificates from Windows. [...]
items.tldr: Microsoft Defenderが正当なDigiCertのルート証明書をTrojan:Win32/Cerdigent.A!dhaとして誤検出し、広範な誤警告を引き起こし、一部のケースではWindowsから証明書を削除しています。

items.title: Telegram Mini Apps abused for crypto scams, Android malware delivery
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have uncovered a large-scale fraud operation that uses Telegram's Mini App feature to run crypto scams, impersonate well-known brands, and distribute Android malware. [...]
items.tldr: TelegramのMini App機能を悪用した大規模な詐欺操作が発覚し、暗号通貨詐欺や著名ブランドの偽装、Androidマルウェアの配布が行われている。

items.title: CISA Adds Actively Exploited Linux Root Access Bug CVE-2026-31431 to KEV
items.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added a recently disclosed security flaw impacting various Linux distributions to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation in the wild. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-3
items.tldr: CISAは、さまざまなLinuxディストリビューションに影響を与える新たに発表されたセキュリティ脆弱性CVE-2026-31431を、実際に悪用されている証拠を基にKnown Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV)カタログに追加しました。

items.title: Critrical cPanel flaw mass-exploited in "Sorry" ransomware attacks
items.description: A new disclosed cPanel flaw tracked as CVE-2026-41940 is being mass-exploited to breach websites and encrypt data in "Sorry" ransomware attacks. [...]
items.tldr: 新たに発表されたcPanelの脆弱性CVE-2026-41940が悪用され、"Sorry"ランサムウェア攻撃によってウェブサイトが侵害され、データが暗号化されている。

items.title: ConsentFix v3 attacks target Azure with automated OAuth abuse
items.description: A new attack type, dubbed ConsentFix v3, has been circulating on hacker forums, building on the previous technique by adding automation and scaling potential. [...]
items.tldr: 新たな攻撃手法「ConsentFix v3」がハッカーフォーラムで広まり、自動化とスケーリングの可能性を加えたOAuthの悪用を通じてAzureを標的にしています。

items.title: Trellix Confirms Source Code Breach With Unauthorized Repository Access
items.description: Cybersecurity company Trellix has announced that it suffered a breach that enabled unauthorized access to a "portion" of its source code. It said it "recently identified" the compromise of its source code repository and that it began working with "leading forensic experts" to resolve the matter imme
items.tldr: Trellixは、ソースコードリポジトリへの不正アクセスによる侵害を確認し、問題解決のために専門のフォレンジックチームと協力していると発表しました。

items.title: Microsoft tests modern Windows Run, says it's faster than legacy dialog
items.description: Microsoft has confirmed that Windows 11 is getting a new modern Run dialog with dark mode support and faster performance in a new preview build. [...]
items.tldr: Microsoftは、Windows 11の新しいモダンRunダイアログをテスト中で、ダークモード対応と従来のダイアログよりも高速なパフォーマンスを提供することを発表しました。

items.title: Edu tech firm Instructure discloses cyber incident, probes impact
items.description: Instructure, the company behind the widely used Canvas learning platform, has disclosed that it recently suffered a cybersecurity incident and is now investigating its impact. [...]
items.tldr: Edu tech企業Instructureが、広く利用されているCanvas学習プラットフォームに関連するサイバーセキュリティ事件を公表し、その影響を調査中であることを明らかにしました。

items.title: 76% of All Crypto Stolen in 2026 Is Now in North Korea
items.description: North Korean threat actors are pulling off historic cryptocurrency heists on a yearly, sometimes weekly basis now. AI might be helping them.
items.tldr: 2026年に盗まれた暗号通貨の76%が北朝鮮に流入しており、北朝鮮の脅威アクターがAIを利用して歴史的な暗号通貨の強奪を行っている。

items.title: 30,000 Facebook Accounts Hacked via Google AppSheet Phishing Campaign
items.description: A newly discovered Vietnamese-linked operation has been observed using a Google AppSheet as a "phishing relay" to distribute phishing emails with an aim to compromise Facebook accounts. The activity has been codenamed AccountDumpling by Guardio, with the scheme selling the stolen accounts back throu
items.tldr: 30,000のFacebookアカウントが、Google AppSheetを利用したフィッシングキャンペーン「AccountDumpling」によってハッキングされ、盗まれたアカウントが再販されていることが報告されました。

items.title: 15-year-old detained over French govt agency data breach
items.description: French authorities have detained a 15-year-old suspected of selling data stolen in a cyberattack on France Titres (ANTS), the country's agency for issuing and managing administrative documents. [...]
items.tldr: フランス当局は、行政文書を発行・管理するフランスTitres（ANTS）へのサイバー攻撃で盗まれたデータを販売した疑いで15歳の少年を拘束した。

items.title: If AI's So Smart, Why Does It Keep Deleting Production Databases?
items.description: The issue isn't artificial intelligence, but rather an industry adding AI agent integrations into production environments before proper security testing.
items.tldr: AI自体の問題ではなく、適切なセキュリティテストを行わずにAIエージェントの統合を生産環境に導入する業界の問題である。

items.title: Cybercrime Groups Using Vishing and SSO Abuse in Rapid SaaS Extortion Attacks
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers are warning of two cybercrime groups that are carrying out "rapid, high-impact attacks" operating almost within the confines of SaaS environments, while leaving minimal traces of their actions. The clusters, Cordial Spider (aka BlackFile, CL-CRI-1116, O-UNC-045, and UNC6671
items.tldr: サイバーセキュリティ研究者は、SaaS環境内で迅速かつ高影響な攻撃を行い、痕跡をほとんど残さないサイバー犯罪グループ「Cordial Spider」の存在を警告しています。
